name: Finseta PLC
summary: Finseta Plc engages in the provision of payment services, foreign exchange and currency risk management. It offers a proprietary cloud-based software platform known as FXPal, which is designed to cater to the needs of small and medium sized enterprises engaged in international trade. The company was founded by Oliver Bridge on January 21, 2013 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
